arxiv-2104-10434.title: Entanglement instability in the interaction of two qubits with a common non-Markovian environment
arxiv-2104-10434.creator: G. Mouloudakis 1,2, P. Lambropoulos 1,2
arxiv-2104-10434.description: Abstract In this work we study the steady state entanglement between two qubits interacting asymetrically with a common non-Markovian environment. Depending on the initial two-qubit state, the asymmetry in the couplings between each qubit and the non-Markovian environment may lead to enhanced entanglement in the steady state of the system, measured in terms of the two-qubit concurrence.

arxiv-2202-01806.title: Answering Count Queries for Genomic Data with Perfect Privacy
arxiv-2202-01806.creator: Bo Jiang Mohamed Seif Ravi Tandon Ming Li
arxiv-2202-01806.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider the problem of answering count queries for genomic data subject to perfect privacy constraints. Count queries are often used in applications that collect aggregate (population-wide) information from biomedical Databases (DBs) for analysis, such as Genome-wide association studies.

arxiv-2202-12356.title: Constraints on the Λ \Lambda -neutron interaction from charge-symmetry breaking of A = 4 A=4 hypernuclei
arxiv-2202-12356.creator: Ulf-G. Meißner
arxiv-2202-12356.description: Abstract We include the leading charge symmetry breaking contributions into the hyperon-nucleon interactions derived within chiral effective field theory up to next-to-leading order. Two low energy constants are determined using the experimentally known differences of Λ \Lambda separation energies of He Λ 4 \prescript{4}{\Lambda}{\rm He} and H Λ 4 \prescript{4}{\Lambda}{\rm H} .

arxiv-2206-01507.title: Can Requirements Engineering Support Explainable Artificial Intelligence? Towards a User-Centric Approach for Explainability Requirements
arxiv-2206-01507.creator: Umm-E- Habiba, Justus Bogner, Stefan Wagner
arxiv-2206-01507.description: Abstract With the recent proliferation of artificial intelligence systems, there has been a surge in the demand for explainability of these systems. Explanations help to reduce system opacity, support transparency, and increase stakeholder trust. In this position paper, we discuss synergies between requirements engineering (RE) and Explainable AI (XAI).

arxiv-2303-08801.title: Slowest and Fastest Information Scrambling in the Strongly Disordered XXZ Model
arxiv-2303-08801.creator: Myeonghyeon Kim, Dong-Hee Kim
arxiv-2303-08801.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Myeonghyeon Kim, Dong-Hee Kim. We present a perturbation method to compute the out-of-time-ordered correlator in the strongly disordered Heisenberg XXZ model in the deep many-body localized regime. We characterize the discrete structure of the information propagation across the eigenstates, revealing a highly structured light cone confined by the strictly logarithmic upper and lower bounds representing the slowest and fastest scrambling available in this system.

arxiv-2306-11028.title: Demonstration of a Quantum Noise Limited Traveling-Wave Parametric Amplifier
arxiv-2306-11028.creator: Nikita Klimovich, Peter K. Day, Shibo Shu, Byeong Ho Eom, Henry G. LeDuc, Andrew D. Beyer
arxiv-2306-11028.description: Abstract Recent progress in quantum computing and the development of novel detector technologies for astrophysics is driving the need for high-gain, broadband, and quantum-limited amplifiers. We present a purely traveling-wave parametric amplifier (TWPA) using an inverted NbTiN microstrip and amorphous Silicon dielectric.

arxiv-2310-19757.title: The colourful antenna subtraction method Preprint: IPPP/23/63 ZU-TH 70/23
arxiv-2310-19757.creator: T. Gehrmann a , E.W.N. Glover b , M. Marcoli a,b
arxiv-2310-19757.description: Abstract We present a general subtraction scheme for NNLO calculations in massless QCD: the colourful antenna subtraction method . It is a reformulation of the antenna subtraction approach designed to address some of the limitations of the traditional framework, especially aiming at high-multiplicity processes.

arxiv-2311-09973.title: Stationary measures on the circle from hyperbolic surfaces with cusps cannot be straightened by quasi-symmetries
arxiv-2311-09973.creator: Aitor Azemar, Vaibhav Gadre
arxiv-2311-09973.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Aitor Azemar, Vaibhav Gadre. Stationary measures on the circle that arise from a large class of random walks on the fundamental group of a finite-area complete hyperbolic surface with cusps are singular with respect to the Lebesgue measure. In particular, it is sufficient for singularity that a stationary measure satisfies an exponential decay for cusp excursions with excursions being measured in the path metric on horocycles bounding cusps.

arxiv-2411-08032.title: R Package moodlequizR: Fully Randomized Moodle Tests.
arxiv-2411-08032.creator: by Wolfgang Rolke
arxiv-2411-08032.description: Abstract This article describes the R [ R Core Team, 2021 ] package moodlequizR , which allows the user to easily create fully randomized quizzes and exams for Moodle, or indeed any online assessment platform that uses XML files for importing questions.

arxiv-2511-06772.title: Broad Feshbach resonance with a large background scattering length in a fermionic atom-molecule mixture
arxiv-2511-06772.creator: Zhen Su, Tong-Hui Shou, Huan Yang, Jin Cao, Bo-Yuan Wang, Ting Xie, Jun Rui, Bo Zhao, Jian-Wei Pan
arxiv-2511-06772.description: Abstract We report the observation of a broad magnetic Feshbach resonance with a large background scattering length in an ultracold fermionic mixture of 23 Na 40 K molecules and 40 K atoms, with both species prepared in their lowest hyperfine states. The Feshbach resonance is characterized by measuring resonantly enhanced loss rates and elastic scattering cross sections via cross-species thermalization.

arxiv-2601-17644.title: A Systemic Evaluation of Multimodal RAG Privacy
arxiv-2601-17644.creator: Ali Al-Lawati, Suhang Wang
arxiv-2601-17644.description: Abstract The growing adoption of multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (mRAG) pipelines for vision-centric tasks (e.g. visual QA) introduces important privacy challenges. In particular, while mRAG provides a practical capability to connect private datasets to improve model performance, it risks the leakage of private information from these datasets during inference.

john-chrysostom-homilies-on-galatians-an.description: Homilies on Galatians and Ephesians — John Chrysostom. From the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Series 1 edition (1887). A principal work of the early church, among the foundational texts of Christian antiquity.

pmc-10595080.title: The impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on delayed care of CVD in Europe: a systematic review
pmc-10595080.creator: Y Khan, N Verhaghe, B Devleeschauwer, L Cavillot, S Gadeyne, N Pauwels, L Van den Borre, D De Smedt
pmc-10595080.description: AimCardiovascular diseases are the leading cause of death worldwide and the COVID-19 pandemic has disrupted healthcare systems, causing delays in essential medical services, including cardiovascular (CV) care. This study aims to estimate the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on delayed cardiovascular (CV) care in Europe by providing a systematic overview of the available evidence.

pmc-10731282.title: Double trouble: compounding effects of COVID-19 pandemic and antimicrobial resistance on drug resistant TB epidemiology in India
pmc-10731282.creator: Aliabbas A. Husain, Rajpal Singh Kashyap
pmc-10731282.description: ed as having one of the highest burdens of drug resistant (DR) pathogens, including multi-drug-resistant TB (MDR-TB), which accounts for a quarter of the global burden (2). A 6-year observational study in south India on the prevalence of DR-TB indicated a high proportion (11%) of rifampicin and isoniazid mono-resistance in new cases (3).

pmc-10735905.title: THE ASSOCIATION OF URINARY INCONTINENCE AND DISABILITY AMONG A DIVERSE SAMPLE OF MID-LIFE SWAN WOMEN
pmc-10735905.creator: Sheila Dugan, Sybil Crawford, Karla Wente, L Waetjen, Carrie Karvonen-Gutierrez, Sioban Harlow
pmc-10735905.description: Few studies have examined the prospective association between urinary incontinence (UI) and disability in midlife women. We assessed associations between UI type, frequency and amount with reported disablity in a racially/ethnically diverse cohort of community dwelling midlife women. Data was from longitudinal analyses of questionnaires from the multi-center, prospective cohort Study of Women’s Health Across the Nation.

pmc-10748361.title: Molecular Epidemiology of Respiratory Syncytial Virus during 2019–2022 and Surviving Genotypes after the COVID-19 Pandemic in Japan
pmc-10748361.creator: Sayaka Yoshioka, Wint Wint Phyu, Keita Wagatsuma, Takao Nagai, Yasuko Sano, Kiyosu Taniguchi, Nobuo Nagata, Kazuhiko Tomimoto, Isamu Sato, Harumi Kaji, Ken Sugata, Katsumi Sugiura, Naruo Saito, Satoshi Aoki, Eitaro Suzuki, Yasushi Shimada, Hirotsune Hamabata, Irina Chon, Teruhime Otoguro, Hisami Wat
pmc-10748361.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). To evaluate the changes in respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) collected between 2019 and 2022, we analyzed RSV-A and RSV-B strains from various prefectures in Japan before and after the COVID-19 pandemic. RT-PCR-positive samples collected from children with rapid test positivity at outpatient clinics in 11 prefectures in Japan were sequenced for the ectodomain of the G gene to determine the genotype. Time-aware phylogeographic analyses were performed using the second hypervariable region (HVR) of the G gene from 2012 to 2022.

pmc-11717377.title: Sporotrichoid Nocardiosis in an Immunocompetent Patient: A Case Report
pmc-11717377.creator: Ivonne De La Hoz, Gabriela De La Hoz, Gurdeep Singh, Manoucher Manoucheri
pmc-11717377.description: Nocardia spp. rarely cause infection in humans and are most common in the immunocompromised population. Pulmonary nocardiosis is the most common presentation. Cutaneous involvement is usually acquired after direct contact.A 71-year-old healthy male patient presented with a non-healing wound in his left leg that had appeared two weeks before. The patient had been engaged in yard work after a hurricane.

pmc-11843272.title: Liver Transplantation for Acute Liver Failure due to Mushroom Poisoning
pmc-11843272.creator: Hayri Canbaz, Attila Bestemir, Sami Akbulut, Sezai Yilmaz, Yusuf Yavuz
pmc-11843272.description: Background/Aims:Liver transplantation is a life-saving approach in some cases of mushroom poisoning, which is one of the important causes of acute liver failure. However, debate continues regarding the timing of liver transplantation. The aim of this study is to retrospectively evaluate the results of patients who underwent liver transplantation due to mushroom poisoning.

pmc-12630734.title: Graph attention-driven relation network for 3D lane detection
pmc-12630734.creator: Yanji Jiang, Yingyang Zhang, Jiayu Bi, Hao Dong, Daqian Liu, Ke Gao, Bowen Fei
pmc-12630734.description: Lane detection is a crucial task in autonomous driving, but existing methods still struggle with occluded, missing, and complex road structures of lanes. To address these issues, we propose a graph attention-based 3D lane detection method—Graph-RMNet. This network enhances the model’s understanding of the three-dimensional distribution of lanes by parsing the topological structure and semantic category relationships between them.

pmc-12996528.title: Surface hydrophobicity and rigidity determines protein corona on orally delivered nanoparticles treating colitis
pmc-12996528.creator: Jiawei Wu, Mingjie Ni, Liyun Xing, Yating Wang, Xi Liu, Yaxian Zheng, Lian Li, Yuan Huang
pmc-12996528.description: Disease-specific protein corona adsorbed on nanocarriers determines in vivo delivery efficiency. Macrophages can orchestrate inflammation resolution and mucosa repair, making them a promising therapeutic target in colitis. Here, we show that surface hydrophobicity and rigidity determine colitis-specific intestinal protein corona (C-IPC) on orally delivered nanoparticles for treating colitis, which improves therapeutic efficiency.

pmc-13239909.title: Reactive Nitrogen–Dominant Plasma Accelerates Diabetic Wound Healing Through Regulated Angiogenesis and TGF‐β Normalisation
pmc-13239909.creator: Yu‐Pin Cheng, Tien‐Yang Chou‐Huang, Chih‐Chia Lee, Hua‐Lin Chen, Kuang‐Yao Cheng, Mu‐Chien Wu, Shih‐Sen Huang, Jiun‐Wen Guo, Jong‐Shinn Wu
pmc-13239909.description: Chronic diabetic wounds persist because of impaired angiogenesis, dysregulated transforming growth factor beta activity and delayed matrix remodelling. Non‐thermal atmospheric pressure plasma therapy represents a potential non‐pharmacologic approach to overcome these barriers. This study compared reactive nitrogen–dominant and reactive oxygen–dominant plasma exposures under identical apparatus conditions in a diabetic wound model.

uslaw-usc-t10-s7152.title: 10 U.S.C. § 7152 — General officers: title of office
uslaw-usc-t10-s7152.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s7152.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel); Chapter 715 (Appointments In The Regular Army). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. An officer holding an appointment as a general officer in the Regular Army may be called a general officer in the Regular Army. In addition, a general officer of the Regular Army in the Medical Corps, Dental Corps, Veterinary Corps.

uslaw-usc-t22-s8006.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 87 (United States And India Nuclear Cooperation). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Congress finds that India is not an MTCR adherent for the purposes of section 2797b of this title.
